# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UNI 1970 union joint — national focus tree.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - The Union Plan 1970 (Soviet Union and the 14 Union republics)
## Generated by the COLDWAR Soviet generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SOV_generator/cw_union.py).
## Concept: project doc claude/mdcw_union_missions_concept.md. Edit the generator, not this file.

# Joint foci (Saadabad style): whoever completes a focus completes it for Moscow and every Union republic in the Union plan.
# completion_reward runs for every member in its own scope (positive only); _joint_originator only for the one who completed it.
# Attached with 'shared_focus = COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan' in COLDWAR_SOV_1970_focus and mdcw_1970_generic_focus.

joint_focus = {
	id = COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan
	icon = GFX_COLDWAR_goal_Five_Year_Plan
	x = 355
	y = 8
	offset = {
		x = -115
		y = -8
		trigger = { has_focus_tree = mdcw_1970_generic_focus }
	}
	cost = 2
	allow_branch = {
		COLDWAR_UNI_union_tag = yes
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_left_union }
	}
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
	joint_trigger = { COLDWAR_UNI_is_member = yes }
	available = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_who_all_trig_tt
			COLDWAR_UNI_is_member = yes
		}
	}
	select_effect = { set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan_in_progress days = 21 } }
	completion_reward = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan"
		add_political_power = 10
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_tree_started
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_draft_unlock_tt
	}
	completion_reward_joint_originator = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan (originator)"
		add_political_power = 25
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_joint_all_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 50
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_the_union_plan_in_progress
		}
	}
}

		}
